items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: He was a very easy man to get along with. He knew what he wanted, and he'd continue until he finished that record out.

ctx.x: He was a very easy man to get along with. He knew what he wanted, and he'd continue until he finished that record out.

All right. And after you spent some time with Conrad Janis, you went with Wilbur De Paris. You worked with Wilbur De Paris for a couple of years, it seems. While we're on that, apparently on "Tiger Rag," when you started recording "Tiger Rag," you used to blow into the snare drum even back as early as that...
